timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.88 today, down 24 cents from a month ago and up $1.19 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.84. Your wallet is cheering quietly.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Fall firearms turkey season ends Saturday, Oct. 31. Last call for gobblers.

timely.label: Halloween
timely.line: Halloween is Saturday, Oct. 31, tomorrow. Hide the good candy now.

timely.label: Clocks Fall Back
timely.line: Daylight saving time ends Sunday, Nov. 1, so clocks fall back one hour and sunset comes an hour earlier. Hug the extra hour while it lasts.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13. Time to make every trip to the stand count.

timely.label: TV Night
timely.line: Tracy Morgan's NBC sitcom 'The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins' returns for season two on Monday, Nov. 2. Couch time just got funnier.

timely.label: Brush Day
timely.line: The American Dental Association promotes National Brush Day on Sunday, Nov. 1, to get everyone brushing twice a day, especially after Halloween's candy rush. Your dentist just smiled.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is next Wednesday, Nov. 11. Time to plan how your family says thank you.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, and runs through Nov. 24. Fill the thermos now.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation postponed winter trout stocking until the second week of November because of warm weather. Trout can wait for sweater weather.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is hosting a free mentored duck hunt in southeast Missouri this December for beginners, who will learn all aspects of duck hunting before a hunt of their own. Ducks, consider yourselves warned.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is hosting a first-time youth antlerless deer hunt in Trenton on Dec. 12 for kids 11 to 15 who are hunter certified; register by Nov. 30. Dress the little hunters warm.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: A free managed deer hunt Dec. 5 and 6 in Boone County is open to anyone 11 or older who has never harvested a deer. First deer, first bragging rights.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: SOOWERY recalled its 8-drawer fabric dressers because they can tip over and trap a child if they are not anchored to the wall, and they violate the mandatory standard for clothing storage units. Anchor yours today.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Fashion Brand Apparel recalled QZH.DUAO children's pajama sets because they violate mandatory sleepwear standards and pose a burn hazard. Check the pajama drawer tonight.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: RootStim recalled minoxidil hair regrowth treatment bottles because they lack child-resistant packaging, which is a child poisoning risk. Check your bathroom shelf.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: BabyCenter's 2026 list keeps Olivia, Noah and Emma in the top 10, while longer names and Greek myth names are climbing. Odysseus might need a nickname.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom hosted her daughter's preschool classmates for a pumpkin painting play date, supplying art supplies, food and drinks, and another mom paid her for it. That's one way to fund the glitter.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes' creamy chicken and tortellini skillet cooks everything in one pan with garlicky Parmesan sauce and spinach, no boiling the pasta separately. One pan, one happy sink.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's fall turkey burgers skip the bun and pile on caramelized apples, shallots and melted Gruyère. Fall on a plate.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's Thanksgiving turkey meatballs pack ground turkey, stuffing mix, onions, celery and herbs into gravy, so Thanksgiving dinner fits in one bite. Leftovers solved before the holiday.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster meal-prepped chicken gyro bowls with a Greek salad that keeps well for several days. Lunch for the week, handled.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Two strength sessions a week can slow the muscle loss that usually begins in your 40s, and you don't need hours at the gym. Your couch will understand.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster suggests hanging tapestries or heavy curtains along exterior walls as a renter-friendly way to improve insulation. Grandma's decor strikes again.
